panel.purpose: Code block and inline code background.

ink.purpose: Headings, titles, links, focus, and selection.

text.purpose: Body prose, ledes, and default code text.

muted.purpose: Labels, dates, identifiers, and inactive navigation.

rule-strong.purpose: Link underlines at rest, blockquote edges, and the active-nav underline.

sev-info.purpose: 7px severity square for Info, and the unknown-severity fallback.

code-string.purpose: Code strings; the only hue in code.

page-title.purpose: H1 of the archive and About; 26px under 760px.

post-title.purpose: Advisory H1; the largest type on the site.

section-heading.purpose: H2 in advisory prose and on About.

summary.purpose: Advisory summary under the metadata block, in ink, across the full column.

body.purpose: Advisory prose and About paragraphs in reading gray, across the full 760px column with no character cap.

row-title.purpose: Advisory title in a register row.

secondary.purpose: Row ledes, metadata, table of contents, navigation, and the year line at 600.

section-nav.purpose: Entries in the sticky section nav, muted, under a 13px muted title.

label.purpose: Table column headers and the table-of-contents heading; muted, sentence case.

mono.purpose: Dates, identifiers, and reference URLs only.

mono-fine.purpose: CVSS vectors in the advisory metadata block, in muted.

motion.name: row-hover
motion.purpose: Register row hover tint; the only transition. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: min-width; the sticky section nav shows in the reading grid's left track and the in-flow table of contents hides.

breakpoints.name: reading
breakpoints.purpose: max-width; the section nav hides, advisories show the in-flow table of contents, and the 760px column centers alone.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: max-width; register rows become stacked grids, the metadata label column narrows to 92px, the table of contents goes to one column, and older and newer links stack. Code blocks stay inside the column.

focus.purpose: Every focusable element; register rows use a -2px inset outline on the whole row.

scrollTracking.value: aria-current="location" on the section-nav entry for the last H2 within 120px of the viewport top; updated once per animation frame on scroll.
scrollTracking.purpose: Keeps the reader's place in long write-ups.

narrative.overview:
The site is the dated register that security researchers already read: a list of advisories, newest first, and behind each row a well-set post. Every surface is near-black ground, warm off-white text, and 1px rules. Nothing is decorated. The findings carry the weight, so the frame stays quiet: no hero, no big display type, no cards, no filters, no pills.

Density is that of a reading list, not a dashboard. One sans family at two weights does all the talking. A monospace face appears only where a reader compares characters: dates, identifiers, and code. The only hue on any page is a 7px severity square, and the code theme is near-monochrome with one sand string color.

The system rejects the corporate security vendor look (advisory tables with filter bars, colored severity pills, gradients, shield imagery) and anything flashy.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only. There's no light theme and no theme toggle.
Flat and ruled: hierarchy comes from 1px rules, weight, and the muted tone, never from fills, shadows, or radius.
Severity is the only hue, as a small square beside an achromatic word.
Mono is limited to dates, identifiers, and code.
Reading pages center one 760px column, with prose at 18px across its full width; the header, archive, and section nav share the wrap's left edge.

rules.name: The Severity Is the Only Hue Rule
rules.body: Outside code strings, the only chromatic color on a page is the 7px severity square. Don't use severity hues for text, fills, borders, badges, row tints, or code tokens.

rules.name: The Ink Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is a step up the gray scale (muted to reading gray to ink), not a color. Links are ink with a strong-rule underline that brightens to ink on hover.

rules.name: The Dark Only Rule
rules.body: The site declares `color-scheme: dark` and ships one palette. Don't add a light theme or a `prefers-color-scheme` branch.

rules.name: The Mono Means Exact Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears on dates (`time`), identifiers, reference URLs, CVSS vectors, and code, and nowhere else. Labels, headings, navigation, and severity words stay in the sans.

rules.name: The No Display Type Rule
rules.body: No size exceeds 34px, and no condensed, all-caps, or tracked display face appears. Titles get their weight from 600 and their position, not from scale.

rules.name: The Shared Frame Rule
rules.body: The header, archive, section nav, and footer start from the wrap's left edge. On reading pages, the 760px column is the only centered element, and every block inside it shares the column's left and right edges. Narrower caps (the 68ch page heading and the 60ch row lede) trim from the right; they never re-center.

rules.name: The Wide Column Rule
rules.body: Prose runs at 18px with a 1.7 line height across the full 760px column. The site owner chose this wider body over a 68ch measure. Don't reintroduce a character cap on prose, or a code-block bleed, without their call.

rules.name: The Rules Not Boxes Rule
rules.body: Group content with horizontal 1px rules above and below, never with an enclosing card, a fill, or a shadow. The only boxed elements are code blocks and inline code.

dos: **Do** use Shadow Ground for every surface, and keep the site dark only.
**Do** show severity as a 7px square beside the achromatic severity word.
**Do** separate groups with 1px hairline rules above and below.
**Do** set dates, identifiers, and code in JetBrains Mono, and everything else in Source Sans 3 at 400 or 600.
**Do** set prose at 18px and 1.7 across the full 760px column, with code blocks and the post header on the same two edges.
**Do** write a `lede` for each advisory so its register row reads as one deliberate line.
**Do** make the whole register row the link, with one inset focus outline.
**Do** keep code near-monochrome, with Sand String as the only hue.
**Do** keep every interactive target at least 44px high.
donts: **Don't** use severity hues as text color, fills, badges, pills, borders, or row tints.
**Don't** add cards, shadows, gradients, rounded corners, or a hero.
**Don't** use display type above 34px, or condensed, uppercase, or tracked display faces.
**Don't** use mono for labels, headings, navigation, or severity words.
**Don't** add filter bars, sort controls, or tag pills to the register.
**Don't** add a light theme or a theme toggle.
**Don't** center anything but the reading column, or let a block inside it (code included) break the column's edges.
**Don't** add icons other than the line arrow.
